name: R5 actionOf guarda -> true
tests: @s38 pins a server field error to its control, focuses it and keeps the draft
@s39 simulates in place, announces the count and never saves
@s40 disables save until the answer arrives and sends exactly one request
@s39 explains every failure the simulation can foresee and repeats the code it does not know
@s38 focuses the control that owns the field the server complained about
@s40 sends a brand new rule exactly as the editor shows it
@s40 sends the trigger, the condition and the criterion the owner picked
@s40 carries the condition and the criterion of the rule it is editing
@s37 adds the new rule to the list instead of replacing it
@s37 still lets a rule be written when the projects could not be read
@s39 previews a webhook notice instead of a resolved task title

name: R5 actionOf guarda -> false
tests: @s37 keeps the endpoint of a webhook rule when only its name changes
